The '''Perthrillia system''' was a part of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Perthrillian nightwasp]]s.<ref name="Mindor" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Perthrillia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-13.<ref name="TEA" />
